features.label: Full-length massage pad
features.text: A viscoelastic pad surrounds the Achilles tendon up to the calf and massages the tendon path as you move.

features.label: Targeted pain relief
features.text: Inner nubs below the ankle bones and fine loops along the tendon create gentle friction that helps relieve pain.

features.label: Compression reduces swelling
features.text: Medical-grade compression boosts circulation to help reduce swelling and support tendon recovery.

features.label: Heel wedges included
features.text: Place the wedges in both shoes to lift the heels and take extra strain off the tendon.

features.label: Soft breathable knit
features.text: Train active knit is gentle on the skin and keeps you comfortable during daily activity or sport.

features.label: Easy on and off
features.text: Grip recesses on the pad and an expansion zone over the shin make putting the support on simple.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: Measure bare skin with a soft tape measure while standing. Keep the tape snug but not tight. Measure around the narrowest part of the lower leg, just above the ankle bones. Match your measurement to the size chart. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee.
